# v1.20.0b1 — Saved AlphaESS dashboard

The default AlphaESS dashboard now has three ordinary saved Home Assistant
views: Overview, Controls and Diagnostics. It no longer waits for a custom
dashboard or view strategy to register.

- Four-node flow with Solar/Grid on the left, Battery/Load on the right and a
  centred inverter. Solid tracks, smooth power-dependent dots, direction labels
  and compact units; no EV branch.
- Native Home Assistant panels for energy, solar strings, battery details,
  settings and diagnostics. Responsive two-column layout stacks on phones.
- Registry-based entity matching supports renamed entities and multiple
  inverters. Disabled, hidden and restored orphan entries are omitted.
- The exact default strategy/recognised beta dashboard is backed up before
  migration at the existing URL. Customised and unrelated dashboards remain
  untouched. Manual edits detach the generated dashboard from registry refreshes.
- Fix the daily house-load accumulator's midnight callback running outside HA's
  event loop. Its calculations, reset boundaries and restore behaviour remain.
- Review Hillview v11.5 and update GitHub/HACS documentation and preview images.
  The existing low-pass coefficient is already aligned. The new Excess Export
  offset and other control differences are documented rather than imported.

The register map, polling and inverter-control implementation are unchanged.
Opening the new flow card only opens entity details; maintenance tiles use
more-info instead of a one-tap action.

## Installation

Enable beta releases in HACS, select **v1.20.0b1**, restart Home Assistant and
refresh the frontend. The default dashboard remains at
`/dashboard-alphaess-native`. Existing sidebar metadata and permissions are kept.
See `docs/saved-dashboard.md` for migration and rollback.

This is a beta for Companion App verification. Local tests cover Home Assistant
2026.10.4 and 2024.12.5, frontend interactions, migration protections, and Chromium
and WebKit at phone/tablet/desktop widths. It has not been deployed to or verified
on a physical inverter or iPhone by these tests. Removing the strategy dependency
addresses that loading path; it does not guarantee against unrelated network or
Companion App failures.

README images are local previews with example data, not connected-inverter
screenshots. The production flow card is rendered directly; native panel
appearance follows the installed HA version/theme.
